name: AGENT-AUDIT-A — Nile Fresh Market
brief: Nile Fresh Market — an ordering app for small Cairo grocery shops, replacing WhatsApp order-taking. Shopkeepers capture neighborhood orders with next-morning delivery. Focus: order tracking, Arabic-first UX, cash-on-delivery, low bandwidth, customer data privacy. Team of 2; pilot in 3 districts.

evidences.title: مقابلة مع صاحبة بقالة (المعادي)
evidences.content: أنا بعيش في المعادي وعندي بقالة صغيرة. الزباين بيكلموني على الواتساب ويطلبوا حاجات من السوبر ماركت. المشكلة إن الطلبات بتتضيع ساعات ومش بعرف أتابع مين استلم ومين لسه. عايزة نظام يسجل الطلب ويبعتلي رسالة بالطلبات الجديدة كل يوم الصبح. الدفع كاش عند التسليم ومفيش فكة كتير معايا. عايزة كمان أعرف أكتر حاجة مطلوبة في الحتة بتاعتي عشان أشتري بكى.

evidences.title: Operations constraints (draft v2)
evidences.content: Orders must be captured before 21:00 for next-morning delivery. Each order must include a delivery time window chosen by the customer. The system shall send an SMS confirmation to the customer when the shopkeeper accepts the order. Delivery radius is limited to 5 km. The app must function on 3G and load under 3 MB per screen. Shopkeepers must be able to mark an item out of stock, and the system shall hide out-of-stock items immediately. Payments are cash on delivery only; card processing is out of scope this year. Customer phone numbers must not be shared with any third party.

evidences.title: Stakeholder sync — pilot scoping notes
evidences.content: اتفقنا النهارده إن الـ pilot هيبقى في 3 areas بس. الـ shopkeeper لازم يكون عنده dashboard بسيط بالعربي. We agreed إن الـ notifications لازم تكون real-time مش SMS بس — WhatsApp optional. Customer support في الـ MVP هيكون phone only. كمان لو الـ order اتلغت مرتين الـ customer يتحظر مؤقتا. Data privacy مهمة — مينفعش نشارك أرقام العملاء مع أي حد. Launch قبل رمضان.

questions.text: ما هي المعايير الدقيقة لتحديد هوية العميل عند الاستلام؟ هل رقم الهاتف كافٍ أم نحتاج لوسائل إضافية؟
questions.rationale: هذا مهم لنموذج الدفع عند الاستلام ومنع الاحتيال. يجب توضيح متطلبات التحقق من الهوية مبكرًا لتجنب المشاكل لاحقًا.
questions.fallbackAssumption: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أن التحقق من رقم الهاتف فقط كافٍ، مع إمكانية إضافة خطوات التحقق الإضافية لاحقًا إذا ظهرت مشاكل.
questions.answer: Pilot covers Maadi, Nasr City and Giza only; other districts later.

questions.text: هل سيكون هناك حد أقصى لقيمة الطلبات للدفع عند الاستلام؟
questions.rationale: هذا يؤثر على إدارة المخاطر للبقالة ويحدد ما إذا كان هناك حاجة لآليات تحقق إضافية للطلبات الكبيرة.
questions.fallbackAssumption: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أنه لا يوجد حد أقصى لقيمة الطلبات للدفع عند الاستلام.
questions.answer: لأ، الدفع كاش بس في المرحلة الأولى ومفيش فيزا خالص.

questions.text: كيف سيتم إدارة الطلبات الملغاة مرتين؟ ما هي الفترة المؤقتة التي سيتم فيها منع العميل من إجراء طلبات جديدة؟
questions.rationale: هذا يتعلق بجودة الخدمة وإدارة السلوك، ويجب تحديده بوضوح لتجنب سوء الفهم بين الفريق والعملاء.
questions.fallbackAssumption: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أن الفترة المؤقتة هي 24 ساعة بعد إلغاء طلبين متتاليين.
questions.answer: (proceeding with uncertainty — assume: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أن الفترة المؤقتة هي 24 ساعة بعد إلغاء طلبين متتاليين.)

questions.text: ما هي المقاييس الدقيقة لنجاح النموذج الأولي في 3 مناطق؟
questions.rationale: تحديد مقاييس النصر منذ البداية ضروري لتقييم نجاح المشروع، خاصة مع ضيق الوقت قبل رمضان.
questions.fallbackAssumption: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أن مقاييس النجاح هي عدد الطلبات اليومية لكل بقالة ورضا العملاء (قياس عبر اتصال هاتفي).

questions.text: كيف سيتم دعم البقالات التي لديها اتصال محدود جداً أو غير مستقر؟
questions.rationale: نظرًا لقيود النطاق الترددي، من الضروري ضمان أن التطبيق يعمل حتى في ظروف الاتصال الأكثر تقييدًا.
questions.fallbackAssumption: إذا تم تجاهل هذا السؤال، افترض أن التطبيق سيعمل بشكل كامل مع الاتصال 3G فقط، مع إمكانية التخزين المؤقت للبيانات دون اتصال.
questions.answer: Success = 80% of orders tracked without a phone call.

candidates.title: Order Tracking System
candidates.description: Shopkeepers need a reliable system to track neighborhood grocery orders to prevent losses and ensure timely delivery, replacing the current WhatsApp-based method which causes orders to be lost.

candidates.title: Low-Bandwidth Arabic Interface
candidates.description: A simple Arabic-first dashboard is needed for shopkeepers to manage orders efficiently, designed to function on 3G connections with minimal data usage.

candidates.title: Cash-on-Delivery Management
candidates.description: The system must support cash-only transactions without card processing, addressing the shopkeepers' need to handle payments without requiring change.

candidates.title: Customer Data Privacy Protection
candidates.description: Implement strict privacy controls to prevent sharing customer phone numbers with third parties, addressing a key concern for both shopkeepers and customers.

stories.title: Arabic Dashboard
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want an Arabic-first dashboard to manage my orders efficiently, so that I can navigate and operate the system comfortably in my native language.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am a shopkeeper, when I log into the system, then the dashboard interface shall display in Arabic by default
Given I am viewing the dashboard, when I navigate through different sections, then all text and labels shall remain in Arabic
Given I am using the dashboard, when I perform order management tasks, then the interface shall provide clear Arabic instructions and feedback
stories.investNote: Meets all INVEST criteria except possibly 'Valuable' as it assumes Arabic is valuable to shopkeepers

stories.title: 3G Compatibility
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to function efficiently on 3G connections with minimal data usage, so that I can manage my orders even with limited or slow internet connectivity.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am using the system on a 3G connection, when I load any screen, then the data transferred shall be less than 3 MB
Given I am navigating between screens, when I load multiple pages, then each individual screen load shall remain under 3 MB
Given I am using the system in an area with poor connectivity, when I interact with the dashboard, then the system shall remain responsive and functional
stories.investNote: Strong INVEST score with clear testability and direct value for shopkeepers in areas with limited connectivity

stories.title: Stock Management
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want to mark items as out of stock and hide them immediately, so that customers cannot order unavailable products and I can manage my inventory efficiently.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am viewing my product list, when I mark an item as out of stock, then that item shall be immediately hidden from customer view
Given I have marked an item as out of stock, when I update the stock status, then the change shall be reflected instantly across all customer interfaces
Given I have marked multiple items as out of stock, when I save my changes, then all selected items shall be hidden immediately
stories.investNote: Excellent INVEST score with immediate business value and clear testability

stories.title: Cash on Delivery
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to support only cash-on-delivery payments, so that I can manage my orders with a simple, familiar payment method in the initial phase.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am processing an order, when I attempt to select a payment method, then only 'cash on delivery' shall be available as an option
Given I am viewing an order, when I check the payment details, then it shall clearly indicate 'cash on delivery' as the selected method
Given I am setting up payment options, when I configure my shop, then no card processing options shall be displayed
stories.investNote: Clear requirement with good testability, though limited by constraint nature

stories.title: Customer Privacy
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to not share customer phone numbers with any third party, so that I can protect customer privacy and comply with data protection requirements.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am viewing customer information, when I access the details, then no phone number fields shall be visible to me
Given I am exporting order data, when I generate a report, then customer phone numbers shall be masked or excluded from the export
Given I am using the system, when any data is transmitted to third parties, then customer phone numbers shall never be included in the transmitted data
stories.investNote: Strong privacy requirement with clear business value and testability

stories.title: Order Notifications
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want to receive real-time notifications for new orders, so that I can promptly acknowledge and process incoming orders.
stories.acceptance:
Given I have enabled notifications, when a new order is placed, then I shall receive a real-time alert
Given I have WhatsApp notifications enabled, when a new order is placed, then I shall receive a notification via WhatsApp
Given I am away from my dashboard, when a new order is placed, then I shall receive a push notification on my mobile device
stories.investNote: Good INVEST score with optional WhatsApp adding flexibility

stories.title: Customer Order Blocking
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to temporarily block customers from placing new orders after two consecutive cancellations, so that I can manage unreliable customers and reduce order processing waste.
stories.acceptance:
Given a customer has cancelled two consecutive orders, when they attempt to place a new order, then they shall be blocked for 24 hours
Given a customer has been blocked, when the 24-hour period expires, then they shall be allowed to place new orders again
Given a customer has been blocked, when they try to place an order, then they shall receive a clear notification about the 24-hour block
stories.investNote: Good business value but may need refinement on how consecutive cancellations are tracked

stories.title: Order Tracking
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to provide order tracking functionality, so that I can prevent orders from being lost and ensure timely delivery.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am viewing an order, when I check its status, then I shall see real-time tracking information
Given an order is in progress, when I update its status, then the tracking information shall be immediately visible to all relevant parties
Given an order appears to be delayed, when I check the tracking, then the system shall highlight any potential issues with the delivery
stories.investNote: Strong requirement with clear business value and excellent testability

stories.title: Order Cutoff Time
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to allow me to capture orders before 21:00 for next-morning delivery, so that I can plan my operations efficiently and ensure timely processing.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am capturing orders, when the time is before 21:00, then I shall be able to place orders for next-morning delivery
Given I am capturing orders, when the time is after 21:00, then the system shall not allow orders for next-morning delivery
Given I am viewing the order cutoff, when I check the time, then the system shall clearly display the 21:00 deadline
stories.investNote: Clear operational requirement with good testability

stories.title: Popular Items Dashboard
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to display the top 5 most frequently requested items in my area based on weekly sales data, so that I can optimize my inventory and stock popular products.
stories.acceptance:
Given I am viewing my dashboard, when I access the analytics section, then I shall see the top 5 most requested items
Given I am viewing the popular items list, when the weekly data updates, then the list shall refresh automatically
Given I am in a specific area, when I view the popular items, then the data shall be relevant to my location
stories.investNote: Good business value but location-based relevance needs clarification

stories.title: Delivery Radius Limit
stories.narrative: As a shopkeeper, I want the system to limit the delivery radius to 5 km from my shop, so that I can manage delivery logistics efficiently and ensure timely service.
stories.acceptance:
Given a customer is placing an order, when they enter their address, then the system shall calculate the distance from my shop
Given the distance exceeds 5 km, when a customer attempts to place an order, then the system shall reject the order
Given I am setting up delivery options, when I configure my service area, then I shall be able to visualize the 5 km radius
stories.investNote: Clear operational requirement with good testability and business value

conflicts.resolution: AUDIT human verdict: keep A, merge wording of B (contradiction).

reqA.ambiguityNote: consecutive cancelled orders could be interpreted differently
reqA.suggestion: The system shall temporarily block customers from placing new orders for 24 hours after exactly two consecutive cancelled orders within a 24-hour period.
reqA.verifyNote: E3 explicitly mentions customers will be blocked temporarily after two consecutive cancelled orders

reqB.text: The system shall allow shopkeepers to capture orders before 21:00 for next-morning delivery.
reqB.ambiguityNote: capture orders is somewhat vague but contextually clear
reqB.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states orders must be captured before 21:00 for next-morning delivery

conflicts.description: REQ-02 requires minimal data usage under 3MB per screen, while REQ-10 displays a dashboard with weekly sales data which might exceed this limit.
conflicts.suggestion: Optimize the dashboard to ensure it stays within the 3MB limit by compressing data and images.
conflicts.resolution: AUDIT human verdict: keep A, merge wording of B (overlap).

reqA.text: The system shall function on 3G connections with minimal data usage (under 3 MB per screen).
reqA.ambiguityNote: minimal data usage is subjective; 'under 3 MB per screen' is specific but 'minimal' is vague
reqA.verifyNote: E2 states the app must function on 3G and load under 3 MB per screen

reqB.text: The system shall display a dashboard showing the top 5 most frequently requested items in the shop's area based on weekly sales data.
reqB.ambiguityNote: vague terms 'simple dashboard' and 'most requested' lack quantification
reqB.verifyNote: E1 mentions wanting to know most requested items but doesn't specify dashboard functionality

conflicts.description: REQ-03 allows hiding out-of-stock items immediately, while REQ-10 shows top 5 frequently requested items which might include out-of-stock items.
conflicts.suggestion: Clarify that the top 5 items list should only display in-stock items or indicate when items are out of stock.
conflicts.resolution: AUDIT human verdict: keep A, merge wording of B (overlap).

reqA.text: The system shall allow shopkeepers to mark items as out of stock, and hide out-of-stock items immediately.
reqA.ambiguityNote: immediately is somewhat vague but generally acceptable
reqA.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states shopkeepers can mark items out of stock and they're hidden immediately

reqB.text: The system shall display a dashboard showing the top 5 most frequently requested items in the shop's area based on weekly sales data.
reqB.ambiguityNote: vague terms 'simple dashboard' and 'most requested' lack quantification
reqB.verifyNote: E1 mentions wanting to know most requested items but doesn't specify dashboard functionality

conflicts.description: REQ-8 requires order tracking functionality while REQ-11 limits delivery radius to 5km, which could partially overlap in terms of delivery management.
conflicts.suggestion: Clarify that order tracking should be optimized for the 5km delivery radius to ensure efficient route planning.
conflicts.resolution: AUDIT human verdict: keep A, merge wording of B (overlap).

reqA.text: The system shall support order tracking functionality to prevent orders from being lost.
reqA.ambiguityNote: vague term 'prevent orders from being lost'; no specific metrics
reqA.suggestion: The system shall maintain order status tracking with at least 95% accuracy and provide alerts for any order without status update for more than 2 hours.
reqA.verifyNote: E1 mentions problem of orders being lost but doesn't specify tracking functionality as solution

reqB.text: The system shall limit the delivery radius to 5 km from the shop.
reqB.ambiguityNote: none - requirement is clear and testable
reqB.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states delivery radius is limited to 5 km

requirements.text: The system shall provide an Arabic-first dashboard for shopkeepers to manage orders efficiently. (edited by analyst audit)
requirements.suggestion: The system shall provide an Arabic-first dashboard for shopkeepers to manage orders with a maximum of 3 clicks per order action.
requirements.verifyNote: E3 explicitly mentions Arabic dashboard for shopkeepers

requirements.text: The system shall function on 3G connections with minimal data usage (under 3 MB per screen).
requirements.ambiguityNote: minimal data usage is subjective; 'under 3 MB per screen' is specific but 'minimal' is vague
requirements.verifyNote: E2 states the app must function on 3G and load under 3 MB per screen

requirements.text: The system shall allow shopkeepers to mark items as out of stock, and hide out-of-stock items immediately.
requirements.ambiguityNote: immediately is somewhat vague but generally acceptable
requirements.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states shopkeepers can mark items out of stock and they're hidden immediately

requirements.text: The system shall support cash-on-delivery payments only; card processing is out of scope for the initial phase.
requirements.ambiguityNote: none - requirement is clear and testable
requirements.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states payments are cash on delivery only, card processing out of scope

requirements.text: The system shall not share customer phone numbers with any third party.
requirements.ambiguityNote: requirement is clear but could specify what constitutes 'sharing'
requirements.verifyNote: E2 and E3 both explicitly state customer phone numbers won't be shared with third parties

requirements.text: The system shall send real-time notifications to shopkeepers for new orders (WhatsApp optional).
requirements.ambiguityNote: vague term 'real-time'; optional implementation makes it untestable
requirements.suggestion: The system shall send notifications to shopkeepers within 30 seconds of new order placement, with WhatsApp as one of two required notification channels.
requirements.verifyNote: E3 explicitly states notifications must be real-time, WhatsApp optional

requirements.text: The system shall temporarily block customers from placing new orders for 24 hours after two consecutive cancelled orders.
requirements.ambiguityNote: consecutive cancelled orders could be interpreted differently
requirements.suggestion: The system shall temporarily block customers from placing new orders for 24 hours after exactly two consecutive cancelled orders within a 24-hour period.
requirements.verifyNote: E3 explicitly mentions customers will be blocked temporarily after two consecutive cancelled orders

requirements.text: The system shall support order tracking functionality to prevent orders from being lost.
requirements.ambiguityNote: vague term 'prevent orders from being lost'; no specific metrics
requirements.suggestion: The system shall maintain order status tracking with at least 95% accuracy and provide alerts for any order without status update for more than 2 hours.
requirements.verifyNote: E1 mentions problem of orders being lost but doesn't specify tracking functionality as solution

requirements.text: The system shall allow shopkeepers to capture orders before 21:00 for next-morning delivery.
requirements.ambiguityNote: capture orders is somewhat vague but contextually clear
requirements.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states orders must be captured before 21:00 for next-morning delivery

requirements.text: The system shall display a dashboard showing the top 5 most frequently requested items in the shop's area based on weekly sales data.
requirements.ambiguityNote: vague terms 'simple dashboard' and 'most requested' lack quantification
requirements.verifyNote: E1 mentions wanting to know most requested items but doesn't specify dashboard functionality

requirements.text: The system shall limit the delivery radius to 5 km from the shop.
requirements.ambiguityNote: none - requirement is clear and testable
requirements.verifyNote: E2 explicitly states delivery radius is limited to 5 km
